response.title: which portable air conditioner uses the least battery per hour
response.answer:
If you're looking for a portable air conditioner that drains the least battery per hour, the most important specification is its power consumption in watts (W).

Lower watts = longer battery runtime.

There are two important categories:

True portable air conditioners: Use a compressor to actually cool the air. Typically consume around 150–1,000+ watts.

Evaporative air coolers: Often consume only 5–60 watts, but they don't provide true air conditioning and work poorly in humid environments.

For battery-powered cooling, I'd focus on compact compressor air conditioners.
